name: drive and reproduce a somatic spike trace through the conversion
definition: verify the converted cell, when driven by a stimulus, produces a membrane-potential trajectory that matches the reference implementation after channel application.
failure_mode: a mismatched mechanism or a wrong model wiring yields a divergent trace

name: emit exactly one legal move per turn avoiding invalid cells
definition: Choose an in-bounds move every turn, never pausing or double-moving, so a move is accepted by the engine.
failure_mode: An invalid turn aborts the game early.

name: emit headline stats and a top-10 table in an exact fixed-width layout
definition: Assemble lines with total traces, unique-site counts, total analyzed counts, then a ranked table with per-entry count and three labeled frame lines, matching the reference output line-for-line including spacing.
failure_mode: Any added/deleted line, altered blank line, or spacing drift breaks the string equality.

name: emit the map with the required cell markers
definition: write a text map file with wall/open/start/exit characters whose rows match ground truth, matching the verifier's whitespace normalization.
failure_mode: extra/missing rows or differing interior cells break equality
